name: Lena Schmidt
bio:
Lena's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to the Nürburgring with her father. Inspired by the vibrant liveries of racing cars, she pursued an apprenticeship in automotive painting, quickly mastering the intricacies of color matching, surface preparation, and application techniques. Her dedication and eye for detail led her to specialize in motorsport paintwork, where she thrives on the challenge of creating visually stunning and aerodynamically optimized finishes for racing machines.

Joining MP Motorsport Junior was a dream come true for Lena. She approaches each project with meticulous precision, ensuring that every layer of paint contributes to both the aesthetics and performance of the car. Her experience allows her to troubleshoot problems efficiently, and she's always looking for innovative ways to improve the painting process. Lena’s loyalty to the team and her unwavering commitment to quality make her an invaluable asset.

Lena’s colleagues often remark on her ability to perfectly replicate vintage racing colors, a skill she honed through years of studying classic motorsport designs. She is also a mentor to junior technicians, patiently sharing her knowledge and expertise.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Lena is slender and has a focused expression, often seen wearing safety glasses.

quirks: Always keeps a small notebook filled with custom color formulas.
Listens to classic rock while working, claiming it helps her focus.
Insists on cleaning her spray guns immediately after each use.
